name: empower-adhd
description: Shape output to genuinely aid and support a user with ADHD. A revision of the popular i-have-adhd skill adding a (very ADHuman) preamble on the traits of certain ADHD personalities. It also reworks the source skill's rules to encourage agents to serve project aims & support persons, such as by taking over tedious tasks, expediting research, & communicating pertinently.
